displayName: Wildflower Meadow Strip + Orchard (NRCS-style pollinator habitat)
benefit: Wildflower meadow strips along orchard headlands provide season-long bloom for native pollinators and host parasitoid wasps that suppress codling moth and oriental fruit moth. NRCS CP42 conservation practice supports the planting financially.

members.title: Drill regional pollinator mix on headlands
members.body: Drill a regional native pollinator seed mix at the rate suggested by NRCS Conservation Practice 327 or 420 in a 20 to 30 ft headland strip. Mow once in late fall, leave standing through winter for nesting habitat.
